name: mcp-email
description: Read, search, triage, file and draft email over IMAP and SMTP: your mailbox as tools for Claude.
long_description: Exposes common email operations as tools: list folders, search and read messages including attachments (text is extracted from PDFs), move and flag messages, and save drafts. Credentials stay on your machine; the model only sees tool descriptions and the text the tools return. Sending and permanent deletion are off by default and can be switched on in the extension settings. The bundle configures one account, named default; more accounts can be added with the manual configuration described in the README.

imap_host.title: IMAP server
imap_host.description: Hostname of the IMAP server, for example imap.gmail.com. Port 993 with SSL is assumed; other ports need the manual configuration from the README.

imap_password.title: IMAP password
imap_password.description: For Gmail an App Password (https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords), not your account password. Stored in the operating system keychain.

smtp_host.title: SMTP server
smtp_host.description: Hostname of the SMTP server, for example smtp.gmail.com. Port 587 with STARTTLS is assumed. The server requires it even while sending is switched off.

smtp_username.title: SMTP username
smtp_username.description: Usually the same as the IMAP username.

smtp_password.title: SMTP password
smtp_password.description: Usually the same as the IMAP password. Stored in the operating system keychain.

from.title: From
from.description: The From address on everything sent or drafted, for example "Jane Doe <jane@example.com>" or just jane@example.com. Leave empty to use the SMTP username; set it if that is not your email address, or to add a display name.

drafts_folder.title: Drafts folder
drafts_folder.description: Full IMAP name of the Drafts folder that saveDraft writes to, for example INBOX.INBOX.Drafts. Leave empty to auto-detect (works for Gmail and most providers); set it only if drafts end up in the wrong place or saveDraft reports that no Drafts folder was found.

spam_folder.title: Spam folder
spam_folder.description: Full IMAP name of the spam/junk folder that moveToSpam uses, for example INBOX.INBOX.Junk. Leave empty to auto-detect.

trash_folder.title: Trash folder
trash_folder.description: Full IMAP name of the trash folder that deleteEmail moves messages to, for example INBOX.INBOX.Trash. Leave empty to auto-detect.

allow_sending.title: Allow sending
allow_sending.description: Let sendEmail, replyEmail and the forward tools actually transmit messages over SMTP. Off by default: those tools then explain the limitation, and saveDraft still writes to the Drafts folder for you to send yourself.

allow_deletion.title: Allow permanent deletion
allow_deletion.description: Let deleteEmail permanently delete messages. Off by default: moveEmail to a Trash folder is the safe alternative.
